Static photos cannot demonstrate mechanical operation or motor health.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical timing may be off, or the needle bar may be damaged.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing a continuous line of stitches through two layers of denim or similar fabric.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring professional mechanical overhaul
